abilities.simplifiedDescription: Torture your enemies by firing powerful blood strikes.

abilities.menuDescription: Valmont uses his blood to bind an Enemy to him, dealing 80/120/160/200/240 (+60%) magical damage over 3s. When binding an Enemy, they are grounded and slowed by 25% for 3s. Valmont steals 10/15/20/25/30% attack speed from the bound Enemy. If Valmont is affected by Crowd Control or the Enemy cuts line of sight or gets far enough away from Valmont, the bind is broken.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Bind an unfortunate Soul to you, dealing damage over time whilst slowing and grounding them. Steal attack speed from them whilst tethered.

abilities.menuDescription: Valmont manifests 5 blood-forged blades above his head. Over the next 0.75s, these blades sequentially launch forward. Each Blade detonates upon impact, dealing 20/29/38/47/56 (+15%) magical damage in a small area.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Manifest replicas of your Blade. After a short delay, they sequentially launch forward, dealing damage in a small area.

abilities.menuDescription: Active: Valmont launches Lilith, dealing 70/90/110/130/150 (+60%) magical damage. Damaging an Enemy grants 20/25/30/35/40% attack speed for 4s. Increasing the level of Bloodbound increases the strike damage of Hemophagia by 8 magical damage.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Actively target Lilith dealing Damage to Enemies in an area whilst gaining Attack Speed. Whenever Bloodbound is leveled, the Damage of Hemophagias is increased.

abilities.menuDescription: Unleash up to 3 swarms of bats, dealing 40/70/100 (+22%) magical damage. Upon hitting the Enemy, bats return to Valmont, restoring 2.5/4.5/6.5 (+2%) health. When hitting Heroes 10x the amount of health is restored instead. Exsanguinate costs 5 Mana more for every Second it is active.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Unleash terrifying swarms of bats that deal magical damage when hitting enemies. The Bats then return and heal Valmont.

abilities.menuDescription: When Valmont deals damage to an Enemy with Crimson Sigil or Bloodbound causes Lilith to strike them, dealing 15/23/31/39/47/23/31/39/47 (Based on Bloodbound Level) (+15%) magical damage. The more attack speed Valmont has, the shorter the delay between strikes is. Whenever any Enemy dies around Lilith, their soul is consumed and you restore 3/4/5/6/7/8/9/10/12/14/17/20/23/26/29/33/37/41-41 Mana (Based on Hero Level). Consuming the soul of an Enemy Hero restores 35% Maximum Mana additionally.
abilities.simplifiedDescription: Lilith hunts her prey, striking Enemies damaged by you. Regenerate Mana by consuming souls of Enemies killed around Lilith. Restoration is increased on Hero Deaths.
